name: 膏满黄肥节礼大闸蟹款
description: 蟹壳油亮、膏黄丰腴，暗调节令礼蟹套图，从食欲开场到礼盒收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal textured backdrop #1E1B18 for hero and info shots, warm off-white #F5F1E8 panels for spec and comparison alternation
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft top light with gentle contact shadows, warm color temperature, moist appetizing highlights on food, no harsh plastic speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark stone or textured charcoal board, occasional round dark ceramic plate and bamboo steamer wood
styleLock.typography: bold Chinese serif-style headlines in one family only, warm off-white #F5F1E8 or champagne gold #D4A017
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in one accent color, simple rounded labels
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale, whole cooked crab reads glossy orange-red in every shot, hero features never covered by props
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium festive fresh-crab ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal background #1E1B18, warm crab-shell orange #C8501E, champagne gold accent #D4A017 and warm off-white text #F5F1E8; warm soft lighting with soft top light and gentle contact shadows, realistic moist food texture with natural steam, never plastic-looking; bold Chinese serif-style headlines in one family only; consistent rounded info labels and thin-line icons; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no plastic-looking food.

shots.intent: 深色底与香料散点衬托油亮蟹壳，第一秒勾起食欲
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree overhead flat-lay, product centered on a round matte dark plate
shots.lighting: soft top light, gentle contact shadow, moist appetizing highlights on the shell
shots.props: scattered whole spices (dried chilies, star anise, cinnamon stick, bay leaf) around the plate edge, a small wooden spoon, none covering the product
shots.textZone: top area one bold headline 「{callout_1}」 in warm off-white #F5F1E8 with a small rounded champagne gold #D4A017 tag above it
shots.promptTemplate: Top-down 90-degree overhead flat-lay hero of {product} served on a round matte dark plate, the plate and crab filling 60-70% of the frame in the center. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Whole spices scattered around the plate edge frame the dish without covering it, with a small wooden spoon tucked into one corner. Soft top light with a gentle contact shadow and moist appetizing highlights on the shell. Background deep charcoal textured #1E1B18. The top area completes the composition with one bold headline 「{callout_1}」 in warm off-white #F5F1E8 and a small rounded tag in champagne gold #D4A017 above it. 8K commercial food ecommerce quality. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no plastic-looking shine, no cut-off edges, no extra text, no hands.

shots.intent: 一秒传达膏满黄肥的核心卖点，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level hero angle, product on the left half
shots.lighting: soft top-left key light, gentle contact shadow, warm highlights on the shell
shots.textZone: right-side info column with one headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one thin-line icon in {accent_color}
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The crab shown at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle filling the left half and 50-60% of the frame, shell glossy and appetizing. The right side carries a compact info column that completes the composition: one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D and one thin-line icon in {accent_color} above it. Background warm off-white #F5F1E8, soft top-left key light, gentle contact shadow, moist realistic shell texture. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented specs or weights, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 竹蒸笼与升腾热气构建家宴场景，让买家代入上桌时刻
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down into an open bamboo steamer
shots.lighting: warm soft window light from the left, 3800K, natural rising steam, soft shadows
shots.background: bamboo steamer wood and dark warm tabletop #2A211B
shots.props: bamboo steamer, a small dish of ginger-vinegar dip at the frame edge, steam wisps, none covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} steaming inside an open bamboo steamer. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, candid documentary feel, the steamer and crab filling 40-50% of the frame in the lower two thirds while natural steam wisps rise through the upper third and complete the composition. Warm soft window light from the left, 3800K, natural rising steam, soft shadows. Background bamboo steamer wood and dark warm tabletop #2A211B. Props: a small dish of ginger-vinegar dip at the frame edge, never covering the product. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered table, no plastic-looking food.

shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing granular roe texture and glistening oils

shots.textZone: narrow vertical band on the right with one short label 「{callout_1}」 in champagne gold #D4A017
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of golden crab roe from {product}, tight zoom on the granular glistening roe surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background deep charcoal #1E1B18. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal because the texture detail is the whole point. A narrow vertical band on the right carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 in champagne gold #D4A017. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking texture, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 结构化规格版位直观呈现大小与规格信息，消除选购疑虑

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow

Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background warm off-white #F5F1E8. Around the product, two rounded spec label rows 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D sit beside the crab, separated by thin-line dividers, and one thin-line icon in {accent_color} marks the top of the column under the core promise headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D, the whole layout reading as one balanced spec card with even margins. provenance.notes: 从 7 张大闸蟹爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌与素材站水印卡（panel-07）、原文案（金秋蟹/传家千年等）、产地（阳澄湖）、规格重量与产量数据，产品一律以 {product} 占位；书法体标题改为一族衬线标题；资质与数据类信息不在图中虚构，由使用方按实际资质补充。
